name: Chicken, Miso & Spring Onion Smash
notes:
Pulled chicken with miso, tahini and mayo, folded through spring onions, cucumber and coriander, piled high on toast.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 2 cooked chicken breasts
• 3 spring onions
• 1 stick celery
• 1 cucumber
• 10g fresh coriander
• 1 tbsp white miso
• 2 tbsp light mayonnaise
• 1 tsp tahini
• 1 tbsp sesame seeds
• 4 slices sourdough
• Salt
• Black pepper

Method:
1. Shred the chicken into bite-size pieces and finely slice the spring onions and celery. Roughly chop the coriander and cucumber.
2. In a bowl, mix the chicken with the miso, mayonnaise and tahini until evenly coated. Fold through the spring onions, celery, coriander, cucumber and sesame seeds until thick, creamy and scoopable. Season with black pepper and a little salt if needed.
3. Pile generously onto toasted sourdough. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 2g, fibre 3g, sugars 3g, sodium 755mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/pulled-chicken-miso-spring-onion-high-protein-smash
